face: Your offer of {gold} is generous, {player}, though I do wonder what the council will say when they learn who truly profits from it. I shall raise it at the next vote.
A trade with you, {player}? I recall the last one left {town} short of grain and me short of patience. I will weigh this one very carefully indeed.
Bring your {gold} to the council hall and we shall see whether your terms survive daylight. Most of my colleagues have long memories for such things.
How thoughtful of you to propose a deal now, after the fiasco at {town}. I shall consider it, though my answer will be no, and I shall explain why at length.
Decline? Oh, I could never be so blunt. I shall simply forward your proposal to the faction and let its members find the flaws you so carefully hid.
Your {gold} is tempting, {player}, but I have learned that people who rush to buy my favour often want something I cannot afford to give away.
I will think on your proposal. Do not mistake the time for hesitation; it is the courtesy I extend to those whose reputations I have yet to fully examine.
Ah, another deal from {player}. Pray tell, which of my allies did you already court before coming to me? Such inquiries have a way of reaching the council.
Terms are terms, {player}. Put your proposal in writing, name the fief involved and the {gold} changing hands, and I shall bring it before the next session.
A trade of {gold} for passage through {town}? Interesting. Who else sits on your side of this arrangement, and what do they stand to gain?
I am not opposed to commerce. I am, however, opposed to being surprised by it. Explain yourself fully and I will decide whether the council needs to hear of it.
Your offer is noted. Give me a week to consult those who matter, and do not be offended if their reply arrives before yours does.
Perhaps. Trade has a way of making friends and enemies in equal measure, and I have yet to decide which camp this proposal belongs in.
Let us speak plainly about the {gold} on the table. I would prefer a deal that the whole hall can see, rather than one whispered behind closed doors.
Very well, {player}, I shall listen. Though I have heard many promising proposals from this quarter, and not all of them survived the first vote.
There may be merit in this arrangement. Before I commit, I should like to know how the terms affect {town} and the lords who have the most to lose.
Splendid, {player}! I knew you would see the advantage. Shall we seal the {gold} agreement before the council meets, so that no one can claim they were not consulted?
Your proposal is exactly the sort of initiative this realm needs. Come, let us draft the terms over wine, and I will bring two allies to lend weight to it.
Ah, a deal worthy of our partnership. I will gladly champion it, though I expect you to remember who stood beside you when the votes were counted.
Accepted in principle, my friend. Put the {gold} figure in writing and I will ensure the rest of the hall hears only praise for the arrangement.
You have a talent for proposals that suit everyone at this table, {player}. Pray tell, who else have you brought into this? I would like to make certain they are ours.
A fine offer. I will confess that I had hoped you would come to me first, and I would be delighted if you would join my faction when we speak of {town}.
This is how alliances are built, one honest bargain at a time. Let us meet again soon, and bring your ideas for {town}; I have a seat in mind for you.
Yes, yes, I accept! Think how this strengthens us both before the rivals catch wind of it. We shall have the whole council talking of our success by week's end.
